summary: Senior front-end lead with 10+ years building responsive single-page applications in React.js and TypeScript, with Angular on enterprise platforms, for Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP, and HCSC, including 6+ years in a leadership role on complex projects (teams of 5–7, architecture, standards, code review). Builds reusable component libraries and design systems from Figma mockups; manages state with Redux / Redux Toolkit and NgRx; integrates REST APIs with OAuth 2.0 / JWT authentication and real-time features over WebSockets. Delivers accessibility to WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 (semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard and screen-reader testing with JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, axe) and front-end performance (Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, memoization). Writes unit and integration tests with Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, and Jasmine; HTML5, CSS3, and SASS/LESS; Git with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins CI/CD. Node.js and Java back-end integration; Agile/Scrum delivery with product, QA, and UX.
